method: Exact connected components of all pairs of RDKit Morgan radius 2, 2048-bit, chirality-free binary fingerprints with Tanimoto >= 0.7, plus existing identity-group links. Exact popcount bounds prune impossible pairs. Duplicate fingerprints are merged before all-pairs search.
fold_assignment: Seed 20261019, descending component size, random tie-break, greedily assign to smallest structure-count fold; no component is cut.
